method: Map CUDA kernel correlation IDs to runtime launch calls contained in scheduler.batch NVTX ranges, keyed by process. Decode graph spans are first-to-last graph kernel per launch, not CPU NVTX duration. Aggregate only complete four-rank steps; rank-averaged kernel sums can overlap and are not wall time. No extrapolation to serving TPOT.

provenance_limits: The exports contain launch arguments and image metadata, not the hashes of dirty runtime source/binaries. No fresh replay summaries or per-request failures were included in remote commit 40a7d7d. Validity above is from observed job logs, not a new audit of client summaries.

shared_batch_reweighted.limitations: Matches actual batch distribution only, not prompts, experts, physical addresses, or context distributions. Samples within one boot are correlated; this is a diagnostic, not statistical parity.
